I spent eight years making websites work. Now I'm heading toward bioengineering: single-cell data, brain tissue, and the tools that make sense of them.

## What I'm learning now

- The command line in depth — [The Linux Command Line](https://linuxcommand.org/tlcl.php) by William Shotts
- Python for data work — [Python for Data Analysis](https://wesmckinney.com/book/) by Wes McKinney
- Algorithms on real biological data — [Rosalind](https://rosalind.info), Bioinformatics Stronghold
- Biology from the ground up — [Khan Academy High School Biology](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/hs-bio)


Next up: probability and statistics, then R and single-cell workflows.
